color.note: Two themes. Light is the default. High contrast is an added theme: text at 7:1 or better, borders at 3:1 or better.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. `ink` and `ink-muted` text read on it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, lesson panels and quiz options. Set apart from `surface` by a `border`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Callouts and the selected quiz option. Text on it is `highlight-ink`.

tokens.name: highlight-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `highlight`.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Level tags, locked badge discs and quiet blocks. Text on it is `sand-ink`.

tokens.name: sand-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `sand`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card outlines, dividers and unselected quiz option outlines. In the light theme it is decorative: a control never relies on it alone.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a progress bar on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always shown with a percentage.

tokens.name: progress-fill
tokens.usage: Filled part of a progress bar.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Sidebar, top bars, feature panels, headings and outlined buttons. The structural colour.

tokens.name: navy-raised
tokens.usage: Progress track and dividers drawn on `navy`.

tokens.name: nav-active
tokens.usage: Fill behind the active navigation item on `navy`. Its text is `gold-soft`.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `navy`.

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `navy`, such as the programme label under the logo.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `sand`. Used instead of pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, meta lines and helper text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, badge discs and the certificate frame. Text on it is `on-gold`. Never used for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `gold`.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Active navigation text, links and highlights on `navy`.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels and gold-toned text on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: required-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `required-bg`: deadlines and required training.

tokens.name: required-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Required tag. Always carries a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `success-bg`: correct answers and completion.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the correct-answer message and Completed tag. Always carries a word or icon.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `highlight`. A solid 3px ring with a 3px offset.

tokens.name: focus-on-navy
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on `navy` and `gold`.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `info-bg`, for information alerts. 8.9:1 on `info-bg`.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of information alerts. Always paired with an icon and the word "Good to know".

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `warning-bg`, for due-soon warnings.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of warning alerts. Always paired with an icon and a lead word.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, checkboxes, switches and pagination links on `surface` and `surface-raised`. At least 4.6:1.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Text in disabled controls, on `disabled-bg`.

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled inputs. Disabled inputs also get a dashed border.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dimmed page behind a modal dialog.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Background of code blocks, terminals and the lab editor. Text on it is `code-ink`, `code-muted` or a syntax token.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Default code text on `code-bg` and `code-line`.

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Line numbers, comments and block headers on `code-bg`. 7.9:1.

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords and the terminal prompt on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings and PASS results on `code-bg`. Always print the word PASS as well.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers and FAIL results on `code-bg`. Always print the word FAIL as well.

tokens.name: code-function
tokens.usage: Function and class names on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: code-line
tokens.usage: Background of a highlighted line of code.

tokens.name: code-border
tokens.usage: Outline and dividers of code, terminal and lab panels.

type.note: Source Serif 4, Source Sans 3 and Source Code Pro are hosted on Google Fonts. Link all three in every page.

families.mono: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page greeting and screen titles. On phones use 30px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Feature card titles and quiz questions.

styles.name: lesson
styles.sample: Feedback is information about how someone's work affects others.
styles.usage: Lesson reading text. Keep lines to 68 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines and helper text. The smallest size for anything a learner must read.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.sample: PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
styles.usage: Uppercase labels and tags. Always set in uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, terminals and inline code. Never smaller than 16px.

styles.name: code-bold
styles.usage: Terminal results and file tab names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside tags and icon pairs.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between progress bar parts and stacked card content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones and gaps between buttons.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Feature card padding and the gap between page sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Certificate and lesson panel padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Page side padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero spacing and empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and the certificate sheet.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, navigation items, quiz options and callouts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Course cards and stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature cards and lesson panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badge discs and avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: A one-pixel-deep edge under the certificate sheet. No other soft shadows are used.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only for things that float above the page: Menu, Modal and Toast.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any button, link row or input.

tokens.name: touch-primary
tokens.usage: Height of the primary gold button.

tokens.name: touch-option
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a quiz option.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of lesson reading text.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Width of the desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: modal-width
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a Modal.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icon beside small text and in buttons.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icon in feature tiles.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Phone TopBar height.

tokens.name: tabbar
tokens.usage: Phone TabBar height.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Fixed sidebar, TopBar and TabBar.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Menu and Tooltip.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modal and its dimmed overlay.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast, above everything.
